title: Open Dental Software - Version 26.2
markdown:
Table of Contents 
Help 
Search
Version 26.2 
See Versions. 
Version 26.2 was released as stable on 11/03/2026 
Features and enhancements will be added to this page as the version progresses. 
Major Changes
Integration with Glidewell 
Send Lab Cases electronically from the Edit Lab Case window 
Available for both Medit and iTero scanners 
Compatible with Open Dental Cloud 
Changes by Category
Appointments Module
Search for multiple blockouts from the Advanced Appointment Search 
Practice/Clinic schedule notes can be viewed from the Appointments Module 
Advanced Appointment Search includes time slots for all selected blockouts in a day 
Appointment estimates are updated when saving an insurance plan 
Account Module
Moved Statement dropdown options to a new window 
Redesigned the Statement options window 
Moved Status History and Misc settings in the Edit Claim window 
DentalXChange Attachment Service supports PDF documents (Also backported to 26.1.64) 
Chart Module 
New preference to display an extraction graphic after the procedure is complete 
Added new procedure code paint type for custom text displayed outside of the tooth chart 
Added the ability to add multiple flags to all selected teeth on the Perio Chart 
Multiple cells can be selected from any editable data row on the Perio Chart 
Added new settings to show values for past exams in the Perio Chart 
Manage Module 
Moved Electronic Billing settings to a new window 
Reconfigured Billing Defaults and added ability to set some settings per clinic 
Allow future dated clockout events in time cards (Also backported to 26.1.63) 
Insurance 
Option to set the default claim form at a provider level 
When combining insurance plans, there is a new detailed warning for mismatched fields 
Automation trigger added when changing a procedure to not bill to insurance 
Tools 
New database maintenance method to fix payments with income transfer issues 
New database maintenance tool to clean up incorrectly dated conversion payments 
Added a new Fee Tool to copy fees from one procedure code to another 
Added a new method to the latency test tool to measure average latency 
Added a new database maintenance method to fix duplicate entry errors when starting a new chat 
New standalone tools to back up and restore MariaDB databases 
Options for automated MariaDB backups added to the built-in Backup Tool 
Added new database maintenance method to move redundant InsVerify entries 
Reports 
Redesigned layout of Report Display Settings 
Redesigned layout of Report Security Permissions 
New option to show prior uncollected balances on the Patient Portion Uncollected report 
Pay Plan column added to Patient Portion Uncollected report 
eServices 
Replacement tag for eReminder templates to insert eClipboard URL 
New setting to limit how far in advance Web Sched appointments can be scheduled 
Vital signs can be imported from eForms 
Miscellaneous 
Global alerts from Open Dental HQ are now displayed in the program Title Bar 
New definition category for Referral Commlog Types 
New preference to set a service connection URL for the Chat tool 
New preference to automatically switch patients' prophy or perio recall based on completed procedures 
New alert when the eConnector fails to reach Open Dental HQ 
New 2026 RxNorms available to import 
Program Links
New bridge for Alliedstar Connect 
New imaging bridge to OrthoComposite 
Deprecated Trojan Express Collect bridge 
Removed support for Suni, an imaging solution that was only compatible with earlier versions of the Imaging Module 
Removed the Ez3D-i Bridge due to compatibility issues 
PayConnect 2.0 is compatible with all versions of Open Dental Cloud 
Global Payments V2 is compatible with all versions of Open Dental Cloud 
TigerView is compatible with Open Dental Cloud 
API 
Definitions added GET Single and PUT 
Subscriptions, made Workstation required and added an error log 
Benefits POST and PUT support ToothRange 
Documents GetMany added ImgType 
ClaimProcs POST and PUT added PendingSupplemental 
ClaimProcs added DELETE 
Appointments POST and PUT check blockout conflict 
PayPlanCharges GET Expected/POST/PUT 
CodeGroups POST and PUT added ShowInHistory, HistProcCode, and IsPerioFourQuads 
CodeGroups GET can now be filtered by IsHidden, ShowInAgeLimit, ShowInFrequency, ShowInOther, and ShowInHistory 
Added CodeGroups DELETE 
CodeGroups PUT ItemOrder can be changed 
 AppointmentTypes added POST, PUT, and DELETE 
InsPlan GET, POST, and PUT added AllowedFeeSched, OrthoType, OrthoAutoProcFreq, OrthoAutoProcCodeNumOverride, OrthoAutoFeeBilled, OrthoAutoClaimDaysWait, and HasPpoSubstWriteoffs 
Definitions POST and PUT added ItemColor 
Benefits GET added optional filters for CovCatNum, CodeNum, and CodeGroupNum
